mcp-victoriametrics's tag v1.120.1 is v1.20.1 tagged wrong: its revision label is v1.20.1's commit, built a month before v1.20.2, and upstream has no such release. Moving to it would be a downgrade

Until P6 merges updates in its nightly window (skynetv2.md → P6 → Merges), the low-risk ones come as one PR a week, opened or updated on Monday morning: every digest and patch, and minors from 1.0 up. Majors, 0.x minors (semver lets those break) and doco-cd (it deploys everything else) still come one PR each. Last in the list, so it wins over the groups above; those stay together inside it.
